To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hyperfinestructures and lifetimes of the Mn I 3d54p z 4p3/ 2, 5/ 2 levels were investigated with laser-atomic-beamspectroscopy.
the hyperfine structure splitting constants of the 3d54sz4p z4pz3/2 and 3d54pz4p z4P5/2 levels were determined with laser-atomic-beamspectroscopy.
the hyperfinestructur of the Mn I 3d54p z4p levels 3/2, 5/2 was measured with laser-atomic-beamspectroscopy and that the lifetime of the J=5 /2 level is shorter than the J=3 /2 level.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the electronic structure, hyperfine structure, and lifetimes of the Mn I 4s4p3/4 levels.
the determination of the hyperfine structure of the MnI 3d54sz4pz4P1/2 and 3d54pz4pz4P5/2 levels.
the determination of the hyperfine- and fine- structure splitting constants and the lifetimes of the levels 3d5 4s4p z 4p3/ 2, 5/ 2 of the Mn I atom.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the lifetime of the 5p3/2 level of Mn I is 970±50 nsec and of the 5P3/2 level is 1120±50 nsec.
the hyperfinestructures are not resolved in the spectra, but the lifetime is determined to be about 1000nsec.
the hyperfine splitting of the Mn I ground state is in the order of 10 MHz and the lifetime of the Mn ground state is about 1 μsec.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hyperfine-structure splitting constant of the 3d54spz4P1/2,3/2 levels of Mn I is negative, while that of the 3p4s2P1/2 level is positive.
we have been able to determine the hyperfinestructural parameters and the lifetimes of the two levels 3d5s4p z 4p3/ 2,5/ 2 in the Mn I spectrum.
the hyperfine structure of the 4p z4 p3/2, 5/2 states is determined to a precision of 0,4%.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hyperfinestructures of the 3d54p levels of Mn I are very sensitive to the spin-orbit interaction.
laser-atomic-beamspectroscopy is a very useful method for measuring hyperfine structure splitting and lifetimes of atomic levels.
the lifetime of the 3d54sp z4p3,2 levels is longer than the 3d5s2 z2p3,2 ones by about 50%.
